cong_thuc: Ctrl+C: copy vung dang boi den (vien nhap nhay kien bo); Esc de thoat vien nhap nhay.
Ctrl+V: paste (dan) vung da copy/cut vao vi tri moi.
Ctrl+X: cut; khac copy o cho vung goc bi xoa trang sau khi paste.
Ctrl+Z: undo thao tac vua xong (nhan nhieu lan de lui nhieu buoc).
Ctrl+F: mo Find (the Find); Ctrl+H: mo Replace (the Replace).
Find Next / Find All: tim tung o / liet ke tat ca; Replace / Replace All: thay tung cho / thay hang loat.
Ctrl+Shift+L: bat/tat AutoFilter (loc du lieu).
Ctrl + phim mui ten: nhay toi goc (dau/cuoi) vung du lieu; Ctrl+Home ve A1.
Ctrl+Shift + mui ten: boi den tu o hien tai toi goc vung (chon nhanh).
Ctrl+PageDown / Ctrl+PageUp: chuyen sang sheet ben phai / ben trai.
Ctrl+Shift+1: dinh dang #,##0.00 (ngan cach nghin + 2 thap phan); +2: gio; +3: ngay; +4: tien $; +5: %.
Alt+= (Alt + dau bang): tu dong chen SUM() cho cot/hang ke tren/trai.
Ctrl+C roi Alt+H+V+V (Paste Values): dan gia tri, bo cong thuc (sau do Enter/OK).
Ctrl+; (cham phay): chen NGAY hien tai; Ctrl+Shift+; : chen GIO hien tai.
Alt+Enter: xuong dong trong cung 1 o (vi du liet ke hang hoa).
Ctrl+A: lan 1 chon vung lien tuc, lan 2 chon ca sheet.
Alt+F1: ve bieu do tu dong tu vung du lieu dang chon.
Shift+Space: chon ca hang; Ctrl+Space: chon ca cot.
Ctrl+Shift+Dau cong (+) roi R/Enter: chen HANG; roi C: chen COT.
Ctrl+Dau tru (-) roi R: xoa HANG; roi C: xoa COT (hop Delete hien ra).
Giu Shift + keo chuot trai: di chuyen/chen hang-cot ma khong de len du lieu cu.
Ctrl+9: an HANG dang chon; Ctrl+0: an COT dang chon (chon nhieu hang/cot roi an de an hang loat); Ctrl+Z undo de hien lai.
Alt+; (Alt + cham phay): chon cac o NHIN THAY (visible) sau khi an hang/cot, bo qua o an khi copy.
Ctrl+E (Flash Fill, tu Excel 2013): gop Ho+Ten thanh ten day du sau khi go mau 1 o (Nguyen Van An), tu dien ca cot.
thuat_toan_quy_trinh: Buoc 1: tai file thuc hanh bai 23, boi den vung du lieu mau de luyen tung phim tat.
Buoc 2: luyen nhom copy-paste: Ctrl+C > chuyen cho > Ctrl+V; Esc thoat; Ctrl+X de thay cut; Ctrl+Z undo.
Buoc 3: luyen Find/Replace: Ctrl+F tim 'hang', Find All; Ctrl+H thay 'du lieu' thanh 'Excel', Replace All; Ctrl+Z undo.
Buoc 4: luyen Filter + dieu huong: Ctrl+Shift+L bat loc; Ctrl+mui ten nhay goc; Ctrl+Shift+mui ten boi den; Ctrl+Home ve A1.
Buoc 5: luyen sheet + dinh dang: Ctrl+PgDn/PgUp chuyen sheet; nhap 1000000/3 roi Ctrl+Shift+1..5 xem 5 kieu.
Buoc 6: luyen tong + gia tri: dung Alt+= tinh tong; copy cot cong thuc roi Alt+H+V+V dan gia tri.
Buoc 7: luyen ngay/gio/xuong dong: Ctrl+; chen ngay, Ctrl+Shift+; chen gio; go text + Alt+Enter xuong dong.
Buoc 8: luyen insert/delete/move: Ctrl+A chon; Alt+F1 ve chart; Shift/Ctrl+Space chon hang/cot; Ctrl+Shift++ (R/C) chen; Ctrl+- xoa; Shift+keo di chuyen.

cau_hoi.cau: Copy vung du lieu dung phim tat nao?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+C
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Boi den roi Ctrl+C, vien nhap nhay la duoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Sau khi Ctrl+C thay hien tuong gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Vien nhap nhay bao vung copy san sang dan.

cau_hoi.cau: Dan vung da copy dung phim nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Chon vi tri moi roi Ctrl+V.

cau_hoi.cau: Thoat vien nhap nhay sau copy/paste bang?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhan Esc de tat che do marching ants.

cau_hoi.cau: Cut (cat) dung phim nao?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+X
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Boi den roi Ctrl+X, vung goc cung nhap nhay.

cau_hoi.cau: Cut khac Copy o diem nao?
cau_hoi.A: Giong het
cau_hoi.B: Cut xoa trang vung goc sau khi paste, Copy giu nguyen
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Cut = di chuyen, Copy = nhan ban.

cau_hoi.cau: Undo thao tac vua xong dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhan Ctrl+Z, nhan nhieu lan lui nhieu buoc.

cau_hoi.cau: Mo hop Find (tim kiem) dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+F mo Find and Replace o the Find.

cau_hoi.cau: Mo thang the Replace (thay the) dung?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+H
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+H nhay thang sang the Replace.

cau_hoi.cau: Tim o tiep theo chua tu khoa dung nut nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Find Next nhay tung o; Find All liet ke het.

cau_hoi.cau: Thay hang loat moi noi dung nut nao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Replace thay tung cho, Replace All thay tat ca.

cau_hoi.cau: Bat/tat loc Filter (AutoFilter) dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhan lai to hop de tat filter.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhay nhanh toi goc phai vung du lieu dung?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl + mui ten phai
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Giu Ctrl + mui ten de nhay toi bien vung.

cau_hoi.cau: Tu o bat ky ve o A1 nhanh nhat?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+Home ve dau sheet tuc thi.

cau_hoi.cau: Boi den nhanh tu o hien tai toi cuoi vung dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them Shift de vua di chuyen vua chon.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon toan bo vung du lieu lien tuc dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ket hop 2 huong de phu kin vung.

cau_hoi.cau: Chuyen sang sheet ben PHAI dung?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+PageDown
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+PgDn sang phai, Ctrl+PgUp sang trai.

cau_hoi.cau: Dinh dang ngan cach nghin + 2 thap phan dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay

cau_hoi.cau: Doi sang dinh dang GIO dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So thap phan hien thanh gio.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi sang dinh dang NGAY THANG dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So serial chuyen thanh ngay thang.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi sang tien te $ dung?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+Shift+4
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them ky tu $ dang tien My.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi sang PHAN TRAM dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Nhan 100 va them dau %.

cau_hoi.cau: Tu dong chen ham SUM dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Alt+= doan vung lien ke roi Enter.

cau_hoi.cau: Dan DAC BIET dang gia tri (bo cong thuc) dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Paste Values chi lay so, mat cong thuc.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen NGAY hien tai vao o dung?
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+; (cham phay)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+; ra ngay hom nay dang ngay.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen GIO hien tai vao o dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Them Shift so voi lenh ngay de ra gio.

cau_hoi.cau: Xuong dong trong cung 1 o dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Alt+Enter ngat dong ma van o mot o.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon nhanh vung du lieu hien tai dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Lan 1 chon vung lien tuc, lan 2 chon ca sheet.

cau_hoi.cau: Ve bieu do tu dong tu vung dang chon dung?
cau_hoi.A: Alt+F1
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Alt+F1 ve chart ngay tren sheet hien tai.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon ca HANG hien tai dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Shift+Space chon hang, boi den them de chon nhieu hang.

cau_hoi.cau: Chon ca COT hien tai dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Ctrl+Space chon cot, boi den 2 cot de chon 2 cot.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen HANG moi dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hop Insert hien ra, go R (=Row) roi Enter.

cau_hoi.cau: Chen COT moi dung? (giong chen hang nhung go C)
cau_hoi.A: Ctrl+Shift+cong (+) roi C (=Column)
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hop Insert hien ra, go C (=Column) roi Enter; boi den 2 o de chen 2 cot.

cau_hoi.cau: Muon chen 2 hang thi lam sao?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Boi den 2 o hang duoi roi Ctrl+Shift++ > R
cau_hoi.giai_thich: So o boi den = so hang duoc chen.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa COT dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Hop Delete hien ra, go C de xoa cot.

cau_hoi.cau: Xoa HANG dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Go R de xoa hang trong hop Delete.

cau_hoi.cau: Di chuyen 2 hang len vi tri khac khong de du lieu dung?
cau_hoi.A: Giu Shift + keo chuot trai toi vach xanh roi tha
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Shift+keo se chen len, khong ghi de.

cau_hoi.cau: Doi 2 cot B va C cho nhau dung?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.B: Boi den cot > Shift+keo sang vi tri moi
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Shift+drag hoan doi ma khong mat du lieu.

cau_hoi.cau: Nhan 2 lan Ctrl+Z sau Replace All thi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Moi lan Ctrl+Z lui 1 thao tac.

cau_hoi.cau: De luyen thanh thao 25 phim tat tac gia khuyen gi?
cau_hoi.A: Khong dung trong bai hoc nay
cau_hoi.D: Tai file va vua xem vua bam theo
cau_hoi.giai_thich: Tai link mo ta, thuc hanh cung video.
